name: saenuri-logo-a
prompt:
Concept: "a church that builds families, where three generations worship together".
One central mark: three simple abstract human figures of different heights (grandparent, parent, child) standing close together, shoulders touching, whose combined silhouette forms the shape of a house roof; the negative space between them forms a simple Christian cross.
Logo symbol for a small, warm Korean Baptist church (about 35 years old, family-centered). It sits at 40 px next to the church name in a website header, so it must stay recognizable at 40 px.
Style: modern flat vector mark, clean geometric shapes, smooth curves, generous negative space, calm and trustworthy, not clip-art, not cartoonish.
Colors: deep navy #13426f as the main color, with at most one soft accent (warm light blue #6fa8dc or soft gold #e8b04a). Solid fills, no gradients, no textures.
Centered with 12% padding on every side. Transparent background.
No text, no letters, no Korean characters, no numbers, no drop shadow, no 3D, no outer frame or badge border, no tiny details.

name: saenuri-logo5-h
prompt:
Concept: five church communities (five colors) come together to build one house, and the empty space between them forms the cross.
One central mark: a simple house silhouette with a pitched roof, cut into exactly five separate pieces by thin transparent gaps.
Layout of the five pieces: a full-width base band at the bottom (green, the foundation); above it the walls split into a left piece (blue) and a right piece (red) by a vertical gap; the roof split into a left slope piece (sky blue) and a right slope piece (orange) by the same vertical gap. The vertical gap plus one horizontal gap between roof and walls together form a clear Christian cross shape in negative space, centered in the house.
Logo symbol for a small, warm Korean Baptist church. It sits at 40 px next to the church name in a website header, so it must stay recognizable at 40 px.
Use exactly these five flat colors, one per piece, each used once: green #2f8f52, red #cf3b2b, blue #2563c9, sky blue #3aa0dc, orange #e8801c. No other colors, no gradients, no textures.
Modern flat vector mark, clean geometric shapes, softly rounded corners, equal gaps between pieces, calm and trustworthy, not clip-art, not cartoonish.
Centered with 12% padding on every side. Transparent background.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no drop shadow, no 3D, no outer frame or badge border, no tiny details.

name: saenuri-logo-mark
prompt:
Flat vector-style church logo mark, centered on a transparent background, square 1024x1024.
Subject: a minimal line-art chapel icon, redrawn cleanly from the reference photo of an engraved plaque: a small pitched-roof chapel with a thin Latin cross on the roof peak, a gable roof drawn as a single outline with slightly extended eaves, a narrow tower body under the gable, two lower side wings with flat roofs on the left and right, and an arched doorway in the center. Front-facing, perfectly symmetric.
Style: uniform monoline stroke (about 4% of the icon width), rounded line caps and joins, no fill, no shading, no gradients, no texture, no metal effect.
Color: single solid deep navy #13426F for every stroke.
Composition: icon occupies about 70% of the canvas, equal margin on all sides.
Must not: no text, no letters, no hearts, no background, no plaque, no shadow, no extra decorations.
